what: A ball half-hanging below the hero swells by .0045× per 1px of scroll (up to 40×) to cover the screen, and the gradient cover ball above it swells to the same size while turning .0015 more transparent per 1px, revealing the solid-color ball beneath — once fully covered, that color becomes the next section’s background. A shadow sits under the ball only while at rest

options.rate: Multiplier that grows per 1px of scroll, default .0045 — original phone version .0038
options.fade: Rate at which the cover ball turns transparent per 1px, default .0015
options.from: 「enter」 counts from the moment the panel’s top edge reaches the bottom of the screen + lead (default counts from the top of the document)
options.lead: Lead distance (px) for from: enter, default 200
options.[data-fx-part=ball]: Swelling ball (required) — position and size are set in the consuming CSS, background is --fx-fill (default --kf-accent)
options.[data-fx-part=over]: Cover ball (optional) — stacked at the same position and size, it swells and turns transparent. Background is a diagonal gradient from --fx-hi → --fx-lo
options.is-rest: Marker attached to the element when scroll is 0 — the shadow under the ball appears only then

from.where: index.html .kg-ball--bg·.kg-ball--over (50rem ball below the hero — original common.min.js: scale(1 + scroll × .0045) up to 40x, cover opacity 1 − scroll × .0015, shadow 0 2rem 2.9rem only when scroll is 0) · on phone the panel uses .0038 from when it comes within 200px of the bottom of the screen
from.options: rate: .0045; max: 40; fade: .0015 · phone version from: enter; lead: 200; rate: .0038

note: A section after the inflating cover ball leaves its background empty (in the original only the lower half of the section has the same color) or uses a lower z than the ball. Section text is raised to a higher z than the ball
